decision_titles: $200,000 Housing Trust Fund request for Dorset Commons
plain_text:
Page 1 
Housing Committee 
September  9, 2026  
 
The Housing Committee held a regular meeting on September 9, 2026 at 6 pm, in City 
Hall, 180 Market Street, and by Zoom. 
Members present: Nora Senecal, Meghan Tedder, Tasos Zois, Sandy Dooley, Dawn 
Philibert 
Also present: Miranda Lescaze, CHT; Elizabeth Fitzgerald, City Councilor; Kelsey Peterson, 
Senior City Planner 
1. Housing Trust Fund: Request for Funding from CHT 
The Housing Committee received a request for $200,000 from the Housing Trust Fund 
from Champlain Housing Trust for part of a project for upgrades, maintenance, and tree 
management at Dorset Commons. CHT provided the site plan, description, and current 
funding layout. Miranda Lescaze for CHT gave description of project as general 
modernization and updates for a property from the 1970s.  
Committee members questions about lead paint, the housing unit income restriction 
distribution, long-term tenancy, and the scope of Phase I of the project. Committee 
members and E. Fitzgerald asked for something written of the income distribution of the 
units (% of AMI limits), asked questions about funding stack and how the funding sources 
are structured and limited, and specifically if the mini-splits were included in Phase I being 
funded (they are not).  
The Housing Committee has set up a meeting on October 6 (instead of the regular 
meeting date on October 14) for consideration of this request and a potential draft 
recommendation from the Committee to City Council. Additional materials were requested 
from CHT by September 18.  
2. Other Business:  
a. Green Community Festival 
N. Senecal volunteered to staff the table for the Housing Committee at the Green 
Community Festival on September 19, potentially with T. Zois. The Committee discussed 
additional resources for the table potentially from CVOEO, Habitat for Humanity, and CHT.
Housing Committee September 9, 2026 | Page 2 
b. Next Meeting 
The Committee decided to review the recommendation on the CHT request with the 
updated materials from CHT. N. Senecal and M. Tedder are to draft the recommendation in 
advance. The agenda shall warn potential action on the CHT request. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:06 pm. 
 
______________________________ 
Clerk
